通过联想循环记忆扩展 LLM 上下文Extending LLM Context via Associative Recurrent Memory

Gleb Kuzmin1,4,8   Ivan Rodkin2,6   Aydar Bulatov3,6   Yuri Kuratov3,6
Lyudmila Rvanova1   Mikhail Katkov9,10   Ilia Sochenkov7   Misha Tsodyks9,10
Timothy Baldwin2   Mikhail Burtsev5   Artem Shelmanov2
1FusionBrain Lab   2MBZUAI   3Cognitive AI Systems Lab   4RUDN
5London Institute for Mathematical Sciences   6MIRAI   7Lomonosov Moscow State University
8Laboratory for Analysis and Controllable Text Generation Technologies RAS
9School of Natural Sciences, Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton
10Department of Brain Sciences, Weizmann Institute of Science
kuzmin.gyu@gmail.com    artem.shelmanov@mbzuai.ac.ae
摘要Abstract

扩展大型语言模型 (LLM) 的上下文长度对于许多现实应用程序至关重要，但标准转换器仍然受到二次计算和线性内存扩展的限制。在这项工作中，我们研究了关联循环记忆变换器（ARMT）作为一种实用方法，用于在 LLM 中实现长上下文处理、恒定的内存扩展和更高的效率。我们做出了三项主要贡献。首先，我们构建两个特定领域的长上下文数据集，旨在评估实际工作负载，重点关注窄域微调场景。其次，我们提出了基于 ARMT 的上下文扩展的综合训练方案，将持续预训练、合成长上下文数据生成、课程学习以及将联想记忆选择性地集成到所选模型层中相结合。第三，我们提出了一项广泛的实验研究，证明 ARMT 增强模型：（i）处理远远超出其原始上下文限制的输入，而不会降低相对于极限基线的性能； (ii) 更有效地推广到分布范围之外的长度； (iii) 需要减少 30% 的 FLOP，同时保留原始上下文窗口内的基线性能。Extending the context length of large language models (LLMs) is critical for many real-world applications, yet standard transformers remain constrained by quadratic compute and linear memory scaling. In this work, we investigate the Associative Recurrent Memory Transformer (ARMT) as a practical approach for enabling long-context processing in LLMs, constant memory scaling, and better efficiency. We make three main contributions. First, we construct two domain-specific long-context datasets designed to evaluate realistic workloads, focusing on narrow-domain fine-tuning scenarios. Second, we propose a comprehensive training recipe for ARMT-based context extension, combining continued pre-training, synthetic long-context data generation, curriculum learning, and selective integration of associative memory into chosen model layers. Third, we present an extensive experimental study demonstrating that ARMT-augmented models: (i) process inputs well beyond their original context limits without degrading performance relative to in-limit baselines; (ii) generalize more effectively to out-of-distribution context lengths; and (iii) need 30% less FLOPs while preserving baseline performance within the original context window.

1 简介Introduction

长上下文理解对于许多任务至关重要，例如处理和理解技术和财务报告、软件开发以及科学和法律领域的多文档推理。这些场景通常需要模型来集成分布在数十万甚至数百万代币上的信息。然而，标准变压器架构Long-context understanding is crucial for many tasks, such as processing and understanding technical and financial reports, software development, and multi-document reasoning in scientific and legal domains. These scenarios often require models to integrate information distributed across hundreds of thousands or even millions of tokens. However, standard transformer architectures(Vaswani et al., 2017)由于自注意力的计算和内存成本随序列长度呈二次方增长，因此难以扩展到此类环境。此外，变压器性能随着上下文长度的增加而降低struggle to scale to such contexts, as the computational and memory costs of self-attention grow quadratically with sequence length. Moreover, transformer performance degrades as the context length increases(Liu et al., 2024; Kuratov et al., 2024)。 因此，自从 Transformer 架构引入以来，长上下文处理已成为一个中心且快速发展的研究方向. Therefore, since the introduction of the transformer architecture, long-context processing has emerged as a central and rapidly-evolving research direction(Beltagy et al., 2020; Katharopoulos et al., 2020; Bulatov et al., 2022)。传统上，高效的长上下文方法是使用循环架构构建的. Traditionally, efficient long-context approaches have been built using recurrent architectures(Gu and Dao, 2024; Peng et al., 2023);然而，此类模型通常必须从头开始训练，从而限制了利用现有预训练法学硕士的能力。此外，完全循环的 LM 在每个时间步都会更新内存，这使得结构化复制等任务中的高级信息处理变得复杂; however, such models must typically be trained from scratch, limiting the ability to leverage existing pre-trained LLMs. Moreover, fully-recurrent LMs update the memory at each time step, which complicates high-level information processing in tasks such as structured copying(Jelassi et al., 2024)和以下说明and instruction following(Park et al., 2024).

最近的研究Recent studies(Bulatov et al., 2024; Rodkin et al., 2024)探索了通过分段上下文处理和循环记忆机制来增强变压器。用人类记忆来类比have explored enhancing transformers with segment-wise context processing and recurrent memory mechanisms. Using human memory as an analogyCowan (2008)，一个分段内的充分注意力模型是短期/工作记忆，而在分段之间循环传播关键信息的模块可以被视为长期记忆。 这些方法保留了强大的段内建模性能，同时实现了上下文长度的线性缩放。, full attention within a segment models short-term/working memory, while the module that recurrently propagates crucial information from segment to segment can be viewed as long-term memory. These approaches preserve strong intra-segment modeling performance while enabling linear scaling with respect to context length.

在这项工作中，我们重点关注关联循环记忆变换器（ARMT：In this work, we focus on the Associative Recurrent Memory Transformer (ARMT:Rodkin et al. (2024)），它引入了一个宽敞的段级关联存储器，并具有对极长输入大小的强大缩放功能。基于 ARMT 的模型的先前工作仅限于低于 200M 参数的规模，并在一组狭窄的任务上进行评估), which introduces a capacious segment-level associative memory and features strong scaling to extremely long input sizes. Prior work on ARMT-based models has been limited to scales below 200M parameters and evaluated on a narrow set of tasks(Rodkin et al., 2024)，使得它们在较大模型尺寸下的行为大多未被探索。这种规模的模型通常很难处理复杂的现实工作负载。在这项工作中，我们将 ARMT 扩展到中小型 LM（1B 参数），它们在实际设置中的能力要强得多。这些模型提供了一个实用的中间立场，支持线性计算、恒定内存长上下文处理，同时在现实任务中保持强大的性能。, leaving their behavior at larger model sizes mostly unexplored. Models at this scale typically struggle to handle complex real-world workloads. In this work, we extend ARMT to small- and medium-sized LMs (1B parameters), which are substantially more capable in practical settings. These models provide a practical middle ground, enabling linear-compute, constant-memory long-context processing while maintaining strong performance on real-world tasks.

我们的贡献如下：Our contributions are as follows:

  • •

    我们根据现实世界的任务构建了两个新的数据集，以训练和评估法学硕士的长上下文性能，重点关注窄域微调。We construct two new datasets over real-world tasks to train and evaluate the long-context performance of LLMs, focusing on narrow domain fine-tuning.

  • •

    我们提出了一种使用 ARMT 扩展法学硕士有效背景的培训方案。这种方法结合了持续的预训练、训练数据的合成生成、课程学习以及将联想记忆机制战略性整合到选定的法学硕士层中。We propose a training recipe for extending the effective context of LLMs using ARMT. This approach incorporates continued pre-training, synthetic generation of training data, curriculum learning, and the strategic integration of the associative memory mechanism into selected LLM layers.

  • •

    我们提出了一项关于使用 ARMT 扩展最先进的法学硕士上下文窗口的实验研究。我们的研究结果表明：(1) ARMT 增强模型处理输入We present an experimental study on extending the context windows of state-of-the-art LLMs using ARMT. Our findings demonstrate that: (1) ARMT-augmented models process inputs远远超出了他们原来的语境限制well beyond their original context limits相对于极限基线而言，不会降低性能； (2) 他们展示without degrading performance relative to in-limit baselines; (2) they exhibit优越的概括性superior generalization与基本模型相比，分布外上下文长度； (3) 他们to out-of-distribution context lengths compared to base models; and (3) they需要减少 30% 的 FLOP 次数need 30% less FLOPs同时保持基准性能while maintaining baseline performance在原来的上下文范围内within the original context limits.

2 相关工作和背景Related Work and Background

近年来，随着法学硕士解决问题能力的发展，对长上下文任务处理的需求不断增长In recent years, the demand for long-context task handling has grown as the problem-solving capabilities of LLMs have evolved(OpenAI, 2023; Reid et al., 2024; Anthropic, 2024)。然而，即使对于狭窄的任务，当上下文大小增加时，小型和大型模型都会经历急剧的性能下降。此外，由于注意力的二次计算复杂性，缩放变压器的上下文在计算上是昂贵的。这个问题已经通过稀疏注意力得到解决. However, even for narrow tasks, both small and large models experience sharp performance degradation when the context size increases. Additionally, scaling the transformer’s context is computationally expensive due to the quadratic computational complexity of attention. This problem has been addressed by sparse attention(Child et al., 2019; Zaheer et al., 2020)，注意力线性化, attention linearization(Wang et al., 2020; Katharopoulos et al., 2020)和循环方法。现代 RNN 因其随长度线性缩放而越来越受欢迎：xLSTM, and recurrent approaches. Modern RNNs are increasing in popularity due to their linear scaling with length: xLSTM(Beck et al., 2024)建立在传统的循环架构之上以实现高效的扩展，RWKVbuilds on traditional recurrent architectures to achieve efficient scaling, RWKV(Peng et al., 2023)以及 Mamba 等状态空间模型and state space models such as Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024)和门控 DeltaNetand Gated DeltaNet(Yang et al., 2024a)利用简单的线性递归来实现更快的并行训练。 完全循环模型在一些长上下文任务上表现出很强的性能；然而，与复杂算法任务中的 Transformer 相比，它们仍然面临重大限制utilize simple linear recurrence to achieve faster parallel training. Fully-recurrent models exhibit strong performance on some long-context tasks; however, they still face significant limitations compared to transformers in complex algorithmic tasks(Jelassi et al., 2024; Merrill et al., 2024), 指令如下, instruction following(Park et al., 2024)和长上下文推理, and long-context reasoning(Kuratov et al., 2024)。有效处理上下文的能力受到固定大小循环状态瓶颈的限制。具有交错注意力和循环层的混合模型. The ability to efficiently address the context is limited by the bottleneck in the fixed-size recurrent state. Hybrid models with interleaving attention and recurrent layers(Lenz et al., 2025; Fu et al., 2025; Qwen Team, 2026)部分解决了这些性能问题，但它们仍然面临着上下文大小昂贵的二次计算扩展，并且需要从头开始训练。partially address these performance issues, but they still face expensive quadratic compute scaling with context size and require training from scratch.

具有分段级递归的模型提供了一个有前途的中间立场：它们在较长序列上保留线性缩放，并在充分关注的情况下保持 Transformer 强大的短上下文性能Models with segment-level recurrence present a promising middle ground: they retain linear scaling on longer sequences and maintain the strong short-context performance of transformers with full attention(Dai et al., 2019; Rae et al., 2020)。 ARMT. ARMT(Rodkin et al., 2024)已被证明不仅可以随上下文大小线性扩展，而且可以有效地处理选定任务上的数千万个令牌。扩展 ARMT 为开发计算效率高、可扩展至极长上下文的法学硕士提供了可能性，并在每个细分市场中保持充分关注的所有优势。has been shown not only to scale linearly with context size, but also to efficiently process tens of millions of tokens on selected tasks. Scaling ARMT opens up possibilities to develop LLMs that are compute-efficient, potentially scalable to extremely long contexts, and maintain all the strengths of full attention within each segment.

ARMT 架构的概述见An overview of the ARMT architecture is presented inFigure˜1。主干LLM被传递到一个包装器，该包装器能够对输入段进行分段处理，将长上下文输入分割成固定长度的非重叠段。每个片段还通过可训练的记忆嵌入（“Mem”）进行增强，这些记忆嵌入在整个模型中进行处理。 ARMT 的核心在于关联块，这是一个分层内存模块，用于检索和更新先前片段的键值关联，并将调用的信息注入当前片段表示中。 联想记忆机制由三部分组成：. The backbone LLM is passed to a wrapper that enables segment-wise processing of input segments, splitting long-context inputs into non-overlapping segments of fixed length. Each segment is also augmented with trainable memory embeddings (“Mem”), which are processed throughout the model. At the core of ARMT lies the associative block, a layerwise memory module that retrieves and updates key-value associations from previous segments and injects the recalled information into the current segment representation. The associative memory mechanism consists of three parts:

  • •

    记忆提取Memory extraction：每个转换器层将输入段压缩到内存嵌入中。: each transformer layer compresses an input segment into memory embeddings.

  • •

    记忆巩固Memory consolidation：然后将内存嵌入作为键值对合并在每层关联矩阵中。: memory embeddings are then consolidated in a per-layer associative matrix as key-value pairs.

  • •

    协会Association：以下片段的每个嵌入都被转换为查询向量并乘以关联矩阵。: every embedding of the following segment is transformed into a query vector and multiplied by the associative matrix.

附录AppendixA给出了关联块的正式定义。presents the formal definition of the associative block.

ARMT 结合了两方面的优点：循环架构在任意长的上下文中传播信息的能力（原则上）以及在有限上下文窗口内完全自注意力的强大性能。 与曼巴相比ARMT combines the best of both worlds: the ability of recurrent architectures to propagate information across arbitrarily long contexts (in principle) and the strong performance of full self-attention within a limited context window. In contrast to Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024)和RWKVand RWKV(Peng et al., 2023)，ARMT 的计算深度随序列长度变化，通过将精确的局部注意力与深度、高容量的长期记忆相结合，实现更有效的多步推理, ARMT’s computational depth scales with sequence length, enabling more effective multi-step reasoning by combining precise local attention with deep, high-capacity long-term memory(Rodkin et al., 2024; Kuratov et al., 2024).

3 通过 ARMT 进行 LLM 上下文扩展LLM Context Extension via ARMT

为了使法学硕士能够处理长上下文，我们开发了一套有效 ARMT 训练所必需的技术：持续预训练、综合长上下文监督、课程学习和 ARMT 层修剪。To enable LLMs to handle long contexts, we developed a set of techniques essential for effective ARMT training: continued pre-training, synthetic long context supervision, curriculum learning, and pruning of ARMT layers.

继续预训练。Continued pre-training.当联想记忆被引入预训练的LLM时，新添加的参数保持未初始化状态。因此，虽然主干 LLM 已经经过预训练，但 ARMT 仍然需要额外的适应来学习如何有效地使用记忆机制。我们假设持续的无监督语言模型预训练可以正确初始化联想记忆参数并简化后续特定于任务的微调。此阶段应在足够长的上下文上执行，以便主动使用记忆机制在多个段之间传播显着信息。在我们的实验中，我们使用了 8 个段。为了使这种持续预训练可行，我们开发了与 DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 兼容的优化 ARMT 实现When associative memory is introduced into a pre-trained LLM, the newly added parameters remain uninitialized. As a result, although the backbone LLM is already pre-trained, ARMT still requires additional adaptation to learn how to use the memory mechanism effectively. We hypothesize that continued unsupervised language-model pre-training can properly initialize the associative memory parameters and simplify subsequent task-specific fine-tuning. This stage should be performed on sufficiently long contexts so that the memory mechanism is actively used to propagate salient information across multiple segments. In our experiments, we used 8 segments. To make such continued pre-training feasible, we developed an optimized ARMT implementation compatible with DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3(Rasley et al., 2020; Rajbhandari et al., 2020).

课程学习。Curriculum learning.当从头开始训练联想记忆层时，ARMT 最初几乎随机地执行具有挑战性的任务，这些任务需要跨多个片段传播显着信息，从而从此类实例中产生很少的有用学习信号。 我们认为，就像人类记忆一样，机器记忆应该通过逐渐增加任务复杂性来训练，即课程学习When associative memory layers are trained from scratch, ARMT initially performs near-randomly on challenging tasks that require propagating salient information across multiple segments, thereby yielding little useful learning signals from such instances. We argue that, much like human memory, machine memory should be trained through a gradual increase in task complexity, i.e. curriculum learningBengio et al. (2009)。 因此，我们在微调过程中应用课程学习，逐步增加任务难度。我们通过最大上下文长度（由 ARMT 段的数量定义）来控制任务难度。具体来说，模型首先学习如何跨 2 个分段传播重要信息，然后是 4 个分段，最后是 8 个分段。 此外，我们在整个课程阶段对学习率进行退火，在后期阶段逐渐降低。. Accordingly, we apply curriculum learning during fine-tuning by progressively increasing task difficulty. We control task difficulty via the maximum context length, defined by the number of ARMT segments. Specifically, the model first learns how to propagate important information across 2 segments, then 4, and finally 8 segments. In addition, we anneal the learning rate across the curriculum stages, gradually reducing it in the later stages.

生成合成的长上下文训练数据。Generating synthetic long context training data.原始训练数据集中可能缺乏长上下文实例；因此，对此类数据进行微调 ARMT 可能具有挑战性。此外，为了使用课程学习，我们需要相对较大的具有特定长度上下文的实例箱。为了缓解这个问题，我们建议生成合成的长上下文训练实例（请参阅第Long context instances might be scarce in the original training dataset; therefore, fine-tuning ARMT on such data might be challenging. Moreover, in order to use curriculum learning, we need relatively large bins of instances that have contexts of specific lengths. To mitigate this problem, we suggest generating synthetic long-context training instances (see Section4了解更多详情）。我们首先从长文档中抽取多个短段落（段落），并为每个段落生成一个问答对。 然后将这些段落连接成一个长上下文，在训练期间用作输入，同时保留原始的 QA 监督。 为了增加生成数据的多样性并减少特定于模型的偏差，我们使用来自不同模型系列的多个法学硕士来生成 QA 对。for further details). We first sample multiple short passages (paragraphs) from a long document and generate a question-answer pair for each passage. These passages are then concatenated into a single long context, which is used as input during training while preserving the original QA supervision. To increase diversity and reduce model-specific biases in the generated data, we produce QA pairs using multiple LLMs from different model families.

关联内存层修剪。Associative memory layers pruning.我们进一步研究每一层是否都需要联想记忆来进行有效的上下文处理。类似于现代法学硕士，仅在层的子集中应用滑动窗口注意力We further investigate whether associative memory is needed in every layer for effective context processing. Similar to modern LLMs that apply sliding-window attention only in a subset of layersTeam et al. (2025)，我们假设联想记忆同样只能保留在选定的层中。 因此，作为可选的效率步骤，我们建议在训练后删除冗余的关联层。 我们还提出了一种预先选择具有关联记忆的层的方法，表明只需几个关联层即可训练 ARMT 模型，并获得与完整 ARMT 模型相当的性能。, we hypothesize that associative memory can likewise be retained only in selected layers. Therefore, as an optional efficiency step, we suggest removing redundant associative layers after training. We also propose a recipe for the pre-selection of layers with associative memory, showing that one can train the ARMT model with only a few associative layers and achieve performance comparable to that of the full ARMT model.

4 长上下文数据集Long-Context Datasets

LLM 上下文扩展的方法依赖于持续的 LM 预训练Approaches to LLM context extension rely either on continued LM pre-training(Gao et al., 2025)或长上下文监督微调（SFT）or on long-context supervised fine-tuning (SFT)(Xu et al., 2024)。持续的 LM 训练的计算成本极高，需要数百个 GPU 小时，而且效果有限。现有的长上下文 SFT 数据集选择很少，并且主要针对选定的领域。在我们的实验中，我们的目标是通过精心制作具有足够多样性、复杂性和大小以及适合课程学习的可控样本长度的长上下文数据集，以计算有效的方式扩展上下文。. Continued LM training is prohibitively computationally expensive, requiring hundreds of GPU hours and is limited in effectiveness. Existing long-context SFT dataset selection is scarce and mostly targets selected domains. In our experiments, we aim to extend the context in a compute-efficient way by carefully crafting long-context datasets with sufficient diversity, complexity, and size, as well as controllable sample length suitable for curriculum learning.

我们使用 ManyTypes4Py 构建训练和评估数据集We construct training and evaluation datasets using the ManyTypes4Py(Mir et al., 2021)和政府报告-QSand GovReport-QS(Cao and Wang, 2022)数据集。我们专注于这些数据集，以证明即使计算资源有限，也可以使用 ARMT 模型在特定领域的数据上进行上下文扩展，同时避免数据集后面的计算要求更高的指令。datasets. We focus on these datasets to demonstrate the possibility of context extension with the ARMT model on domain-specific data, even with limited compute resources, while avoiding more compute-demanding instruction following datasets.

多类型长 (MT)ManyTypes-long (MT)目标是具有长上下文的代码中的变量类型预测。我们将原始数据集拆分为不重叠的存储库，用于训练、验证和测试拆分，并堆叠每个存储库中的代码脚本，以获得所需长度最多 64k 标记的长文本。我们重用了 ManyTypes4Py 中变量类型的原始标签targets variable type prediction in code with long context. We split the original dataset into non-overlapping repositories for training, validation, and test splits, and stacked the code scripts from each repository to obtain a long text with the desired length of up to 64k tokens. We reused the original labels for the variable types from ManyTypes4Py(Mir et al., 2021).

长政府报告 (GR)GovReport-long (GR)专注于长文档问答。原始的 GovReport-QS 由三元组 {报告、问题、答案} 组成，报告中每个问题都有事实段落。我们使用报告中的真实段落，并将它们与不相关的段落混合，保持段落顺序以构建长度高达 64k 的数据集。 由于原始数据集的大小有限，我们使用合成示例来增强训练分割以创建 GR-100+，同时保持验证集和测试集不变。focuses on long-document question answering. The original GovReport-QS consists of triplets {report, question, answer} with ground-truth paragraphs in the report for each question. We used ground-truth paragraphs from the report and mixed them with non-relevant paragraphs, keeping the paragraph order to build datasets of up to 64k in length. Due to the limited size of the original dataset, we augment the training split with synthetic examples to create GR-100+, while keeping the validation and test sets unchanged.

对于这两个数据集，我们将问题放在上下文之前，以减少对参数知识的依赖。 MT 和 GR 数据集的示例参见For both datasets, we place the question before the context to reduce reliance on parametric knowledge. Examples of MT and GR datasets are presented inTables˜6和and7在附录中in AppendixB.1。数据集统计数据提供于. Dataset statistics are provided inTable˜5在附录中in AppendixB.1.

5 实验Experiments

5.1 实验装置Experimental Setup

我们实验的主要目的是证明 ARMT 与所提出的训练技术一起可以：（1）有效扩展基础 LLM 的上下文容量； （2）用分段注意力机制替换完全二次自注意力，该机制仅在一个小的局部窗口内保持二次注意力，同时通过循环记忆机制保留原始LLM的性能。为此，我们进行了一项实验，比较了基础 LLM 和 ARMT 增强 LLM，其中本机上下文窗口相对于基础模型大幅减少（至 1,024 个标记），并且长上下文处理的主要负担放在循环记忆机制上，而不是完全的自注意力。这意味着，例如，如果我们处理 32k 大小的上下文，我们需要将其分成 32 个片段，每个片段中的全注意力仅跨越 1k 个标记，并且重要信息通过内存传播。The main objective of our experiments is to demonstrate that ARMT, together with the proposed training techniques, can: (1) effectively extend the context capacity of the base LLM; and (2) replace full quadratic self-attention with a piece-wise attention mechanism that remains quadratic only within a small local window, while preserving the performance of the original LLM through the recurrent memory mechanism. To this end, we conducted an experiment in which we compared the base LLM and an ARMT-augmented LLM in which the native context window is drastically reduced relative to the base model (to 1,024 tokens), and the primary burden of long-context processing is placed on the recurrent memory mechanism instead of full self-attention. This means, e.g., that if we process a 32k size context, we need to split it into 32 segments, in each of which the full-attention only spans 1k tokens, and important information is propagated through memory.

基础法学硕士。Base LLMs.我们用 Gemma-3-1B-IT 进行了实验We experimented with Gemma-3-1B-IT(Team et al., 2025)和 SmolLM-2-360M-ITand SmolLM-2-360M-IT(Allal et al., 2025)作为基础法学硕士。as base LLMs.

选择 Gemma-3-1B-IT 是因为它是 1B 参数类别中强大的最先进模型，同时仍然具有相对有限的最大上下文长度 32k 标记。此外，即使在这个标称上下文窗口内，它在长上下文设置中也表现出显着的性能下降Gemma-3-1B-IT was selected because it is a strong state-of-the-art model in the 1B-parameter category, while still having a relatively limited maximum context length of 32k tokens. Moreover, it exhibits substantial performance degradation in long-context settings, even within this nominal context window(Team et al., 2025)。我们假设这是由于在其架构中使用了交错滑动窗口注意力而不是单一的完全注意力。因此，该模型是上下文扩展的良好候选者。 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 也非常适合我们的实验：它足够小，可以在有限的 GPU 内存预算下进行训练，但就其尺寸而言仍然具有很强的能力。其有限的 8k-token 上下文窗口使其成为上下文扩展的自然候选者。. We hypothesize that this arises from the use of interleaving sliding-window attention in its architecture instead of monolithic full attention. Therefore, this model is a good candidate for context extension. SmolLM-2-360M-IT is also well suited for our experiments: it is small enough to train under a limited GPU memory budget, yet remains highly capable for its size. Its limited 8k-token context window makes it a natural candidate for context extension.

评估和指标。Evaluation and metrics.我们在训练集上对模型进行了微调，并在 MT 和 GR 测试集上评估了它们的性能。 我们对 MT 数据集使用了精确匹配 (EM) 指标，因为目标答案很短并且需要精确的变量类型预测。对于 GR 和 GR-100+ 数据集，我们使用 ROUGE-LWe fine-tuned the models on the training sets and evaluated their performance on the test sets of MT and GR. We used the exact match (EM) metric for the MT dataset, as the target answers are short and require precise variable type prediction. For the GR and GR-100+ datasets, we use the ROUGE-L(Lin, 2004)公制，因为 GR 中的真实答案是自由形式且相对较长。metric, as the ground-truth answers in GR are free-form and relatively long.

培训细节。Training details.我们使用 LoRA 微调法学硕士We fine-tune the LLMs using LoRA(Hu et al., 2021)GPU 内存效率。 我们使用的训练设置来自for GPU memory efficiency. We used the training setup fromSection˜3对于 GR 和 MT 数据集。 Gemma-3 ARMT 模型的持续预训练是在 FineWeb-Edu 的 19B 代币上进行的for both the GR and MT datasets. Continued pre-training of the Gemma-3 ARMT model was conducted on 19B tokens from FineWeb-Edu(Penedo et al., 2024)。我们还在合成长上下文 QA 任务上尝试了额外的 ARMT 预训练。 附录中提供了训练超参数. We also experimented with additional ARMT pre-training on a synthetic long-context QA task. Training hyperparameters are provided in AppendixE.

5.2 计算效率分析Analysis of Computational Efficiency

GPU内存消耗GPU memory consumption是 ARMT 的主要优点，因为当序列长度增加时它保持不变，而即使是最有效的完全自注意力实现也至少是线性扩展的。这在is the main advantage of ARMT, as it remains constant while the sequence length increases, whereas even the most efficient implementations of full self-attention scale at least linearly. This is illustrated inFigure˜2(a)：对于 Gemma，内存消耗随着上下文长度的增加而增加，最终可能超出内存限制。相比之下，ARMT 不需要额外的内存来处理更长的序列，因此它可以使用更大的批量大小。例如，在 Gemma 处理批量大小为 8 的 65k-token 序列所需的相同内存预算下，ARMT 可以使用批量大小 32 处理相同长度的序列。(a): for Gemma, memory consumption grows as the context length increases and can eventually exceed memory limits. In contrast, ARMT does not require additional memory to process longer sequences, so it can use larger batch sizes. For example, under the same memory budget required by Gemma to process a 65k-token sequence with a batch size of 8, ARMT can process sequences of the same length using a batch size of 32.

FLOP 和令牌吞吐量。FLOPs and token throughput.扩展批量大小不会自动增加令牌吞吐量，因为 GPU 核心可能已经饱和。然而，由于 ARMT 中的自注意力仅在短的、固定大小的片段内呈二次方，因此与基于完全注意力的模型相比，ARMT 需要的自注意力 FLOP 数要少得多。对于长度序列Scaling the batch size does not automatically increase token throughput, since GPU cores may already be saturated. However, because self-attention in ARMT is quadratic only within short, fixed-size segments, ARMT also requires substantially fewer self-attention FLOPs than full-attention-based models. For a sequence of lengthTT和段大小and segment sizeSS，ARMT 将全局注意力 FLOP 减少了大约, ARMT reduces global-attention FLOPs by approximatelyT/ST/S;为了; forT=32,768T{=}32{,}768和andS=1,024S{=}1{,}024，这对应于, this corresponds to a𝟑𝟐×\mathbf{32\times}减少全局注意力的失败次数。当考虑前馈和投影层时，ARMT 理论上总共需要比我们近似下的 Gemma 少大约三分之一的 FLOP；看到reduction in global-attention FLOPs. When feed-forward and projection layers are taken into account, ARMT theoretically requires roughly one-third fewer FLOPs in total than Gemma under our approximation; seeSection˜A.1进行完整的推导。for the full derivation.

Figure˜2(b) 通过说明平均令牌推理时间来实证验证这种减少。对于批量大小为 8 的情况，由于分段的顺序处理和 GPU 核心的利用率不足，ARMT 比基本模型慢。然而，当我们将批量大小增加到 32 时，ARMT 的性能大大优于基本 Gemma 模型。优化的 ARMT 实施可以进一步提高效率(b) empirically validates this reduction by illustrating the average token inference time. For a batch size of 8, ARMT is slower than the base model due to the sequential processing of segments and the under-utilization of GPU cores. However, when we increase the batch size to 32, ARMT substantially outperforms the base Gemma model. Optimized ARMT implementations could further improve efficiencySivtsov et al. (2025).

5.3 模型性能分析Analysis of Model Performance

扩展基础法学硕士的上下文窗口。Extending the context window of base LLM.Gemma-3 在 MT 数据集上的主要结果显示在The main results with Gemma-3 on the MT dataset are shown inFigure˜3(a)和andTable˜1（另见(see alsoTable˜8在附录中in AppendixC）。未经微调的基本模型在所有上下文长度上都实现了接近于零的性能，凸显了特定于任务的适应的必要性。在 8k 上下文（Base、MT、8k）上进行微调后，该模型在达到其最大支持长度 32k 令牌的情况下表现良好，但由于上下文截断，其性能急剧下降，超过此限制。). The base model without fine-tuning achieves near-zero performance across all context lengths, highlighting the necessity of task-specific adaptation. After fine-tuning on 8k contexts (Base, MT, 8k), the model performs well up to its maximum supported length of 32k tokens, but degrades sharply beyond this limit due to context truncation.

相比之下，ARMT 在超过 32k 代币后没有表现出任何降级。值得注意的是，在仅使用 4k 上下文的课程训练之后，ARMT 已经泛化到长达 65k 的输入，证明了循环记忆机制的有效性。最终的 ARMT 模型（ARMT、MT、8k）与域内输入（小于 8k）上的微调基础模型相匹配，同时显着提高了分布外 (OOD) 上下文长度（大于 8k）的性能。In contrast, ARMT shows no degradation beyond 32k tokens. Notably, after curriculum training with only 4k contexts, ARMT already generalizes to inputs as long as 65k, demonstrating the effectiveness of the recurrent memory mechanism. The final ARMT model (ARMT, MT, 8k) matches the fine-tuned base model on in-domain inputs (less than 8k) while substantially improving performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) context lengths (larger than 8k).

Gemma-3 在 GovReport-long-100+ 上的结果显示在The results with Gemma-3 on GovReport-long-100+ are presented inFigure˜3(b), Table˜2并在and inTable˜9在附录中in AppendixC。他们表现出类似的趋势。基本模型实现了低零样本域内性能（ROUGE-L 0.116），并在 GR-100+ 上进行微调后提高到 0.306。它的性能在 Long-OOD 输入上大幅下降 (0.175)。 ARMT 部分缓解了这种退化，将 Long-OOD 性能提高到 0.215，仅在较短的上下文中进行了较小的权衡。. They exhibit a similar trend. The base model achieves low zero-shot in-domain performance (ROUGE-L 0.116) and improves to 0.306 after fine-tuning on GR-100+. Its performance drops substantially on Long-OOD inputs (0.175). ARMT partially mitigates this degradation, improving the Long-OOD performance to 0.215, with only a minor trade-off on shorter contexts.

SmolLM 的实验显示出类似的模式（Experiments with SmolLM show a similar pattern (Tables˜23和and24在附录中in AppendixD.6）。虽然经过微调的基础模型性能下降到超出其本机上下文长度 (8k)，但 ARMT 仍可在高达 32k 令牌的情况下保持竞争性能。). While the fine-tuned base model degrades beyond its native context length (8k), ARMT maintains competitive performance up to 32k tokens.

总的来说，这些结果突出了两个主要发现：（1）ARMT 与所提出的训练技术一起有效扩展了基础模型处理更长输入的能力； (2) 对于属于原始 LLM 的本机上下文窗口内的上下文，我们具有循环记忆的分段注意机制 很大程度上保留了原始全注意力模型的性能。 结合恒定的内存消耗和估计 FLOP 减少 30%Overall, these results highlight two main findings: (1) ARMT, together with the proposed training techniques, effectively extends the ability of the base model to handle longer inputs; and (2) for contexts that fall within the original LLM’s native context window, our piecewise attention mechanism with recurrent memory largely preserves the performance of the original full-attention model. Combined with constant memory consumption and the estimated 30% reduction in FLOPs derived inSection˜5.2，这些结果证明了ARMT强大的实际适用性。, these results demonstrate the strong practical applicability of ARMT.

与其他基线的比较。Comparison to other baselines.我们微调了 1.3B 参数的 Mamba-2 模型We fine-tuned a 1.3B-parameter Mamba-2 model(Dao and Gu, 2024)在 MT 和 GR-100+ 数据集上（on the MT and GR-100+ datasets (Figure˜3）。 Mamba-2 是状态空间模型的一种变体，它显示出与 Transformer 相当的性能和序列长度的线性缩放，使其适用于长上下文任务。 尽管 Mamba-2 处理长上下文 (32-64k) 的能力比基础全注意力 LLM（基于 MT）更好，但在这种情况下它的表现仍然大大低于 ARMT。然而，在较短的上下文中（在 MT 上），Mamba-2 的表现优于 ARMT 和基础全注意力模型，这可归因于较大的模型尺寸。总体而言，ARMT 比其他基线表现出更好的长度泛化能力。曼巴 的其他结果). Mamba-2 is a variant of a state space model that shows comparable performance with transformers and linear scaling in sequence length, making it feasible for long-context tasks. Although Mamba-2 handles long contexts (32–64k) better than the base full-attention LLM (on MT), it still substantially underperforms ARMT in this setting. However, in shorter contexts (on MT), Mamba-2 performs better than ARMT and the base full-attention model, which can be attributed to the larger model size. Overall, ARMT shows better length generalization than other baselines. Additional results for Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024), 曼巴-2, Mamba-2(Dao and Gu, 2024), 达美网, DeltaNet(Yang et al., 2024b)和 xLSTM, and xLSTM(Beck et al., 2024)报告于are reported inTable˜40（附录(AppendixJ）。我们还将 ARMT 模型与更简单的 RMT 模型进行了比较). We also compared the ARMT model with the simpler RMT model(Bulatov et al., 2022)，它不使用关联内存层（, which does not use associative memory layers (Table˜36在附录中in the AppendixG）。结果表明，与 RMT 相比，先进 ARMT 架构中引入的联想记忆机制大大提高了性能和泛化能力。). Results show that the associative memory mechanism introduced in the advanced ARMT architecture substantially improves performance and generalization compared to RMT.

其他长上下文基准。Other long-context benchmarks.我们在 BABILong 上进一步训练和评估 ARMTWe further trained and evaluated ARMT on BABILong(Kuratov et al., 2024)和来自 SCROLLS 的 ContractNLIand ContractNLI from SCROLLS(Shaham et al., 2022)验证训练配方和模型。结果报告于to validate the training recipe and model. The results are reported inTables˜38和and39（附录(AppendixI）和) andTable˜37（附录(AppendixH）。在这两个基准上，采用所提出的训练程序的 ARMT 均优于基本全注意力模型。). On both benchmarks, ARMT with the proposed training procedure outperforms the base full-attention model.

消融：合成数据。Ablation: synthetic data.为了研究合成数据的影响，我们使用不同比例的合成样本在 GR 变体上训练 ARMT（附录To study the impact of synthetic data, we train ARMT on GR variants with different proportions of synthetic samples (AppendixD.4, Figure˜5）。添加合成的长上下文数据可以持续将性能提高到一定程度，之后增益就会饱和。 GR-100+ 获得了最佳结果，对应的合成与真实比率为 5.5，我们在后续实验中使用该比率。). Adding synthetic long-context data consistently improves performance up to a moderate scale, after which the gains saturate. The best results are achieved with GR-100+, corresponding to a synthetic-to-real ratio of 5.5, which we use in subsequent experiments.

Ablation：继续预训练。Ablation: continued pre-training.我们分析了在特定任务微调之前持续预训练对 ARMT 的影响We analyze the effect of continued pre-training on ARMT prior to task-specific fine-tuning inFigure˜3并在and inTables˜10和and11在附录中in AppendixD.2。从 Gemma-3-1B-IT 开始，我们添加一个具有 1024 个令牌段的未初始化关联存储器，并继续在 19B FineWeb-Edu 令牌上进行预训练. Starting from Gemma-3-1B-IT, we add an uninitialized associative memory with 1024-token segments and continue pre-training on 19B FineWeb-Edu tokens(Penedo et al., 2024)使用8段序列。 预训练 ARMT 模型的损失曲线如下所示using 8-segment sequences. The loss curves of the pre-trained ARMT model are presented inFigure˜4在附录中in AppendixD.1。预训练后，使用课程学习在 GR-100+ 数据集上对模型进行微调。. After pre-training, the model is fine-tuned on the GR-100+ dataset using curriculum learning.

持续的预训练持续提高域内和域外上下文长度的性能。它有效地初始化关联内存，使模型能够跨段传播信息，并使这种功能在微调期间更容易利用。Continued pre-training consistently improves performance for both in-domain and out-of-domain context lengths. It effectively initializes the associative memory, enabling the model to propagate information across segments and making this capability easier to exploit during fine-tuning.

消融：课程学习。Ablation: curriculum learning.为了进一步检验课程学习的作用，我们还对没有课程安排的预训练 ARMT 模型（ARMT w/o CL）进行了微调。如图所示To further examine the role of curriculum learning, we also fine-tune the pre-trained ARMT model without curriculum scheduling (ARMT w/o CL). As shown inTable˜10在附录中in AppendixD.2，这种更简单的训练程序实现了与基于课程的变体相当的性能，这表明仅持续的预训练就足以有效地初始化联想记忆。 然而，根据我们的结果，对于没有持续预训练的模型，课程学习是必要的。, this simpler training procedure achieves performance comparable to the curriculum-based variant, indicating that continued pre-training alone is sufficient to effectively initialize associative memory. However, according to our results, for models without continued pre-training, curriculum learning is necessary.

关联层修剪和选择。Associative layer pruning and selection.将关联记忆层添加到预训练的 LLM 中会增加可训练参数的数量和训练成本，并且随着插入的关联记忆层改变 LLM 的内部表示而增加重新适应的需要。 这激发了以下 RQ：Adding associative memory layers to a pre-trained LLM increases the number of trainable parameters and training cost, and adds the need for re-adaptation as inserted associative memory layers alter the internal representations of LLM. This motivates the following RQ:有效的联想记忆集成所需的最小架构转换是什么？法学硕士的哪些层对于引入联想记忆最重要？what is the minimal architectural transformation needed for effective associative memory integration, and which layers of the LLM are most important for introducing associative memory?为了研究这一点，我们进行了两组实验：（1）微调后，我们用恒等函数替换 ARMT 层的子集； (2) 在微调之前，我们仅将关联记忆引入到 LLM 层的子集中。To investigate this, we conduct two sets of experiments: (1) after fine-tuning, we replace a subset of ARMT layers with an identity function; (2) we introduce associative memory only into a subset of LLM layers before fine-tuning.

第一个（修剪）实验的结果提供在The results of the first (pruning) experiment are provided inTables˜12和and13在附录中in AppendixD.3适用于 MT 和 GR-100+ 数据集。对于这两个数据集，最重要的层集中在网络的第三季度（第 13-18 层），而早期层（0-6）贡献最少，可以在训练后删除而不会损失性能。for the MT and GR-100+ datasets. For both datasets, the most important layers are concentrated in the third quarter of the network (layers 13–18), while the early layers (0–6) contribute the least and can be removed after training without performance loss.

细粒度的烧蚀进一步表明，只有少数层是关键的，其中第 14 层始终是最重要的。仅保留 top-1 或 top-4 层可以保持性能，将关联层的数量减少多达六倍。 详细的逐层烧蚀结果提供于Fine-grained ablations further show that only a few layers are critical, with layer 14 consistently being the most important. Retaining only the top-1 or top-4 layers preserves performance, reducing the number of associative layers by up to six times. Detailed layer-wise ablation results are provided inTables˜15和and16在附录中in AppendixD.3.

在第二个实验中，我们研究了在微调之前是否可以仅将联想记忆添加到 LLM 层的子集。根据之前的分析，我们首先仅使用 4 个最重要的层在 GR-100+ 和 MT 上训练 ARMT 模型（参见In the second experiment, we investigate whether we can add the associative memory only to a subset of LLM layers before fine-tuning. We first train ARMT models on GR-100+ and MT using only the 4 most important layers according to the previous analysis (seeTable˜14在附录中in AppendixD.3和andTable˜3）。在 GR-100+ 上，具有最重要 ARMT 层的模型的整体性能略低于完整的 ARMT 模型，但在 Long-OOD 子集上表现更好。在 MT 数据集上，这样的模型优于完整的 ARMT 模型。缺点是识别重要层需要先训练完整的ARMT模型，这并不方便。). On GR-100+, the model with the most important ARMT layers achieves slightly lower overall performance than the full ARMT model but performs better on the Long-OOD subset. On the MT dataset, such a model outperforms the full ARMT model. The drawback is that identifying important layers requires training a full ARMT model first, which is not convenient.

为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一个To address this limitation, we propose a通用预选策略universal pre-selection strategy：中间两层，最后一层，第一节和最后一节各一层。对于具有 Gemma-3-1B-IT（26 层）的 ARMT，这对应于第 7、13、14、19 和 25 层。此配置优于 MT 和 GR-100+ 上的完整 ARMT 模型（: two middle layers, the final layer, and one layer in each of the first and last quarters. For ARMT with Gemma-3-1B-IT (26 layers), this corresponds to layers 7, 13, 14, 19, and 25. This configuration outperforms the full ARMT model on both MT and GR-100+ (Figure˜3, Table˜14在附录中in AppendixD.3和andTable˜3），同时消除了先前层重要性分析的需要。它还减少了可训练参数的数量，并将微调速度加快了 30%（请参阅), while eliminating the need for prior layer importance analysis. It also reduces the number of trainable parameters and speeds up fine-tuning by 30% (seeTable˜4).

其他消融。Other ablations.我们还在 GR-100+ 上训练之前评估了 ARMT 在合成 QA 数据上的监督预训练（We also evaluated the supervised pre-training of ARMT on synthetic QA data prior to training on GR-100+ (Table˜22在附录中in AppendixD.5）。尽管这提高了域内性能，但它降低了长上下文泛化能力，可能是由于合成数据中的序列长度有限。相比之下，持续的语言模型预训练对于初始化联想记忆更有效。). Although this improves in-domain performance, it degrades long-context generalization, likely due to limited sequence lengths in the synthetic data. In contrast, continued language model pre-training is more effective for initializing associative memory.

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了一个实用的方法，使用 ARMT 来扩展法学硕士在特定领域任务上的上下文长度。所提出的方法结合了多种技术：（i）持续预训练，（ii）合成长上下文数据生成，（iii）课程学习，以及（iv）关联层的可选修剪。这些组件共同使小型本地模型能够实现强大的长上下文理解，有助于缩小无法依赖基于远程 API 的 LLM 的隐私保护应用程序的重要差距。 ARMT 还可以实现任意长上下文的恒定 GPU 内存利用率，并将 TFLOP 减少 30%。 我们引入了两个用于在长上下文任务中训练和测试法学硕士的数据集：ManyTypes-long 和 GovReport-long。 最后，我们表明只有少数最重要的层需要使用 ARMT 进行增强。 基于这一观察，我们提出了一种通用策略，用于在微调之前预先选择用于增强的层。我们的实验表明，仅使用 20% 的关联层微调 ARMT 就足以匹配完整 ARMT 模型的性能，同时将训练时间减少约 30%。We present a practical recipe for extending the context length of LLMs on domain-specific tasks using ARMT. The proposed approach combines several techniques: (i) continued pre-training, (ii) synthetic long-context data generation, (iii) curriculum learning, and (iv) optional pruning of associative layers. Together, these components enable small local models to achieve strong long-context understanding, helping to close an important gap for privacy-preserving applications that cannot rely on remote API-based LLMs. ARMT also enables constant GPU memory utilization for arbitrarily long contexts and a 30% reduction of TFLOPs. We introduced two datasets for the training and testing of LLMs in long-context tasks: ManyTypes-long and GovReport-long. Finally, we show that only a few of the most important layers need to be augmented with ARMT. Based on this observation, we propose a universal strategy for pre-selecting layers for augmentation prior to fine-tuning. Our experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning ARMT with only 20% of the associative layers is sufficient to match the performance of the full ARMT model while reducing the training time by approximately 30%.

局限性Limitations

由于论文的选定范围和计算限制，我们仅对相对较小的法学硕士（最多 1B 参数）进行了实验。但是，我们认为此设置仍然很重要，特别是对于实际的特定于域的部署。We experimented only with relatively small LLMs (up to 1B parameters) due to the chosen scope of the paper and computational constraints. However, we argue that this setting is still important, especially for practical domain-specific deployments.

尽管我们在涵盖代码、问答和文档理解的多个长上下文基准上训练和评估了 ARMT，但我们的研究仍然只涵盖了可能的长上下文任务和模式的一个子集。未来的工作应该在更广泛的任务和领域中评估所提出的方法。Although we trained and evaluated ARMT on multiple long-context benchmarks that covered code, question answering, and document understanding, our study still covers only a subset of possible long-context tasks and modalities. Future work should evaluate the proposed approach across a broader range of tasks and domains.

最后，我们对联想记忆的分析主要集中在 ARMT 架构内的层级消融上。尽管我们确定了对长上下文性能贡献最大的关联层子集，但关联记忆如何与转换器表示交互的基本机制仍然只有部分被理解。Finally, our analysis of associative memory focuses primarily on layer-level ablations within the ARMT architecture. Although we identify a subset of associative layers that contribute most to long-context performance, the underlying mechanisms of how associative memory interacts with transformer representations remain only partially understood.

我们以有限和受控的方式使用人工智能助手，其目的有两个：(i) 生成用于微调模型的合成训练数据；(ii) 提高手稿的语法和清晰度。人工智能工具是根据其预期目的使用的，并仔细考虑了负责任和道德的研究实践。We used AI assistants in a limited and controlled manner for two purposes: (i) generating synthetic training data for fine-tuning of the models and (ii) improving the grammar and clarity of the manuscript. The AI tools were used according to their intended purpose and with careful consideration of responsible and ethical research practices.

道德考虑Ethical Considerations

这项工作的重点是提高小型法学硕士的长上下文能力，用于隐私敏感环境中的本地部署。通过在不依赖大型外部服务的情况下高效处理长文档，所提出的方法可以帮助降低处理机密或专有信息时数据泄露的风险。This work focuses on improving long-context capabilities of small LLMs intended for local deployment in privacy-sensitive environments. By enabling efficient processing of long documents without reliance on large external services, the proposed approach can help reduce the risks of data leakage when handling confidential or proprietary information.

这项工作中使用的数据集来自之前发布的来源。我们不会在所提供的数据集中引入新的个人或敏感数据。The datasets used in this work are derived from previously published sources. We do not introduce new personal or sensitive data in presented datasets.

与其他法学硕士技术一样，改进的长上下文处理可以更有效地分析大量文本，这些文本可能会被滥用于大规模信息提取或监视。As with other LLM technologies, improved long-context processing can enable more effective analysis of large collections of text, which could potentially be misused for large-scale information extraction or surveillance.

因此，我们鼓励仔细评估下游部署，特别是在涉及敏感数据的设置中，并建议在释放派生资源时保持数据集构建和模型限制的透明度。We therefore encourage careful evaluation of downstream deployments, particularly in settings involving sensitive data, and recommend transparency about dataset construction and model limitations when releasing derived resources.

D.1 ARMT语言建模预训练ARMT language modeling pre-training

为了更公平地比较 ARMT 微调和其他预训练模型的微调，我们还对 ARMT 增强的 Gemma-3-1B-IT 进行了小规模预训练。该模型使用来自 FineWeb-Edu 数据集的 19B 个标记进行训练，使用长度为 8,192 个标记的串联文本样本，这些样本被分为 8 个段，每个段有 1,024 个标记。For a fairer comparison between ARMT fine-tuning and the fine-tuning of other pre-trained models, we also conducted a small-scale pre-training of Gemma-3-1B-IT augmented with ARMT. The model was trained on 19B tokens from the FineWeb-Edu dataset, using concatenated text samples of length 8,192 tokens, which were split into 8 segments of 1,024 tokens each.

ARMT 和 Gemma 参数都经过充分训练。我们使用了 0.5M 代币的批量大小、学习率为 1e-5 以及具有 5k 预热步骤的线性预热调度器。在Both ARMT and Gemma parameters were fully trained. We used a batch size of 0.5M tokens with a learning rate of 1e-5 and a linear warmup scheduler with 5k warmup steps. InFigure˜4，我们展示了 ARMT 预训练收敛性与使用最终检查点从 1、2、4 和 8 段计算的损失值的比较。, we show the ARMT pre-training convergence compared to the loss values computed from 1, 2, 4, and 8 segments using the final checkpoint.

预训练在 8×H100-80GB GPU 集群上花费了大约 100 个小时。The pre-training took approximately 100 hours on an 8×H100-80GB GPU cluster.

D.2 预训练后的ARMT微调ARMT Fine-Tuning After Pre-Training

在 ARMT 预训练之后，我们还使用与 ARMT 模型相同的设置进行微调，而无需在 GR-100+ 和 MT 数据集上继续进行预训练。结果显示在After ARMT pre-training, we also conducted fine-tuning using the same setup as for the ARMT model without continued pre-training on GR-100+ and MT datasets. The results are shown inTables˜10和and11。对于这两个数据集，预训练极大地提高了下游任务的性能，特别是对于长度从 8k 到 65k 的长上下文样本。. For both datasets, pre-training substantially improves performance on downstream tasks, especially for long-context samples from 8k to 65k in length.

D.3 关联记忆层的消融研究Ablation Study for Associative Memory Layers

我们对 MT 和 GR-100+ 数据集的经过训练的 ARMT 模型中的关联层进行了逐层消融。结果显示在We conducted a layer-wise ablation for associative layers in a trained ARMT model for the MT and GR-100+ datasets. The results are presented inTables˜15, 16, 17和and18。对于 GR-100+ 数据集，最重要的表示来自第 14、25、9 和 13 层，而其他层的贡献要少得多。对于 MT 数据集，最重要的表示来自第 14、18、25 和 19 层。层从起始嵌入层开始编号（即，第 0 层在嵌入层之后，而第 25 层在最后一层之前）。我们假设中间层对于联想记忆来说是最重要的，因为这些层包含比较低或较高层更抽象的表示。在较低层上，这些表示仍未形成，而在较高层上，它们接近目标标记。. For the GR-100+ dataset, the most important representations are from the 14th, 25th, 9th, and 13th layers, while other layers contribute substantially less. For the MT dataset, the most important representations are from the 14th, 18th, 25th, and 19th layers. Layers are numbered from the starting embeddings layer (i. e., the 0th layer goes after the embeddings layer, while the 25th layer goes right before the last layer). We suppose that the middle layers are the most important for the associative memory, as these layers contain the more abstract representation than the lower or higher layers. On the lower layers, these representations are still not formed, while on the higher ones, they are close to the target tokens.

我们还将课程学习期间的训练动态与前 4 个联想块和预选联想块进行了比较，结果显示在We also compared the training dynamics during curriculum learning with top-4 associative blocks and with pre-selected associative blocks, the results are presented inTables˜19和and20。预选的块显示出更好的最终性能，同时不需要从完全训练的模型中进行额外的层消融。我们建议，这种在训练前进行关联块选择的通用方法可以减少训练参数的数量，几乎不会损失性能。. The pre-selected blocks show better final performance while not require additional layers ablation from a fully trained model. We suggest that this universal recipe for associative block selection before training can reduce the number of trained parameters almost without loss of performance.

In this section, we provide additional results with the base GR dataset without additional synthetic data; the results are provided inFigure˜5并在and inTable˜21.

人们可以注意到，GR 数据集的基本版本包含足够的样本来微调 Gemma-3-1B-IT 模型，但不足以微调 ARMT 模型。One can notice that the base version of the GR dataset contains enough samples to finetune the Gemma-3-1B-IT model, but not enough to finetune the ARMT model.

D.5 SFT 消融研究Ablation Study for SFT

我们还对 ARMT 模型进行了额外的 SFT 实验。我们假设使用关联块和内存令牌的冷启动权重进行训练可能会限制模型的性能，该模型是在有限的数据上进行训练以进行微调的。为了检查这一点，我们创建了一个额外的综合 QA 数据集，其中包含法学硕士在自然长上下文样本上生成的 QA 对。我们不断使用 Gemma-3-1B-IT 主干对 ARMT 模型进行预训练，并使用标准课程学习设置在 GR-100+ 数据集上对其进行微调。由于资源有限，我们仅在 1024 个 token 的两个片段上预训练模型。结果显示在We also conducted additional SFT experiments for the ARMT model. We hypothesize that training with the cold-start weights for associative blocks and memory tokens could limit the performance of the model, which is trained on limited data for fine-tuning. To check this, we created an additional synthetic QA dataset with LLM’s generated QA pairs over natural long-context samples. We continuously pre-trained the ARMT model with the Gemma-3-1B-IT backbone and finetuned it on the GR-100+ dataset with the standard curriculum learning setup. Due to limited resources, we pre-train the model only on the two segments of 1024 tokens. The results are presented inTable˜22.

虽然与非预训练的 ARMT 相比，这种训练设置使我们能够在域内长度上实现更高的性能，但在长上下文样本上的性能较差。我们假设这种性能下降可能是由于预训练中文本长度有限造成的。 然而，这种训练设置显示出有希望的结果，并留待未来的研究。While this training setup allows us to achieve higher performance on in-domain lengths compared to the non-pretrained ARMT, the performance on long-context samples is worse. We hypothesize that this performance drop could arise from the limited length of texts in pre-training. However, this training setup shows promising results and is left for future research.

D.6 ARMT 骨干消融研究Ablation Study for ARMT Backbone

Tables˜23和and25显示了带有 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 主干的 ARMT 模型的 GR-100+ 的主要结果以及该模型的关联层消融，同时show the main results on GR-100+ with ARMT model with SmolLM-2-360M-IT backbone and associative layer ablation for this model, whileTables˜24和and26在 MT 数据集上显示相同的结果。show the same results on the MT dataset.

我们还在 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 模型上扩展了 GR-100+ 数据集的联想记忆消融研究，结果呈现在We also expanded the associative memory ablation study on GR-100+ dataset on SmolLM-2-360M-IT model, the results are presented inTables˜27, 28, 29和and30。可以看出，关联层的重要性也取决于模型，表明对于 GR-100+ 上的 SmolLM-2-360M-IT，第 0 层是最重要的一层，而 MT 上第 23 层是最重要的。然而，对于GR-100+来说，重要性最高的4个关联层是第0、23、30和20，而对于MT来说，前4个关联层是第23、24、17和14，因此中间层表示的重要性仍然很高。. As one can see, the importance of associative layers also depends on the model, showing that for SmolLM-2-360M-IT on GR-100+ the 0-th layer is the most important one, while the 23-rd is the most important on MT. However, the top-4 associative layers by importance are 0-th, 23-rd, 30-th, and 20-th for GR-100+ and 23-rd, 24-th, 17-th, and 14-th for MT, so the importance of the middle layer representations is still high.

与 Gemma-3-1B-IT 一样，我们还通过 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 主干展示了 ARMT 课程学习期间的训练动态As was done for Gemma-3-1B-IT, we also show the training dynamics during the curriculum learning for ARMT with the SmolLM-2-360M-IT backbone with预先选择的关联块pre-selected associative blocks，结果显示在, the results are presented inTables˜31和and32。预选块使用与 Gemma-3-1B-IT 相同的通用模式，在最后一层上添加关联层、两个中间层、第三和第四季度之间的两层以及第一和第二季度之间的一层。这里我们在第三季度和第四季度之间添加了一层，因为 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 模型有 32 层，而不是 Gemma-3-1B-IT 的 26 层，导致编号为 8、16、17、23、24、31 的层上有关联层。尽管此模式没有按 GR-100+ 的重要性在 top-1 层上添加关联层，但它仍然实现了性能与完整模型相当，仅使用 20% 的关联层。此外，与完整的 ARMT 模型相比，在 MT 上，这种方法提高了长上下文样本的性能。. The pre-selected blocks use the same universal pattern as described for Gemma-3-1B-IT, adding associative layers on last layer, two middle layers, two layers between third and fourth quarter, and one layer between first and second quarter. Here we added one more layer between the third and fourth quarters, as the SmolLM-2-360M-IT model has 32 layers instead of 26 for Gemma-3-1B-IT, resulting in associative layers on layers numbered 8, 16, 17, 23, 24, 31. Although this pattern does not add an associative layer on top-1 layer by importance for GR-100+, it still achieves a performance comparable to the full model, using only 20% of associative layers. Moreover, on MT this approach improves performance on long-context samples compared to the full ARMT model.

附录FAppendix F内存大小消融Memory Size Ablations

在我们的实验中，没有持续预训练的 ARMT 模型使用了 16 个记忆标记，而预训练的变体使用了 32 个记忆标记。我们假设较大的内存大小在预训练期间是有益的，而 16 个内存令牌足以进行直接微调。具有 16 和 32 个记忆标记的 ARMT 模型（均未经预训练进行训练）之间的比较见In our experiments, the ARMT model without continued pretraining used 16 memory tokens, whereas the pretrained variant used 32 memory tokens. We hypothesize that a larger memory size is beneficial during pretraining, while 16 memory tokens are sufficient for direct fine-tuning. The comparison between ARMT models with 16 and 32 memory tokens, both trained without pretraining, is presented inTables˜34和and35。总体而言，具有 16 个记忆标记的模型在所有数据分割中实现了更好的性能，并在课程学习过程中表现出更强的泛化能力。. Overall, the model with 16 memory tokens achieves better performance across all data splits and demonstrates stronger generalization during curriculum learning.

附录一Appendix I巴比长结果BABILong Results

为了进一步验证所提出的 ARMT 微调方法，我们在 BABILong 基准上进行了实验To further validate the proposed ARMT fine-tuning approach, we conducted experiments on the BABILong benchmarkKuratov et al. (2024)，它提供了适合微调的训练集。由于缺乏训练集，我们没有使用其他流行的长上下文基准，例如 RULER, which provides a training set suitable for fine-tuning. Due to the absence of a train set, we did not use other popular long-context benchmarks, such as RULER(Hsieh et al., 2024)和长凳and LongBench(Bai et al., 2024)。我们在最多 5120 个令牌的序列上训练了基本 Gemma-3-1B-IT 模型和 ARMT 模型。对于 ARMT，我们使用的课程包含 2、3 和 5 个片段，每个片段包含 1024 个标记，而基础模型直接在长度为 5120 的序列上进行训练。所有模型都针对来自 BABILong 基准的任务 QA1-QA5 进行联合训练。结果显示在. We trained both the base Gemma-3-1B-IT model and the ARMT model on sequences of up to 5120 tokens. For ARMT, we used a curriculum with 2, 3, and 5 segments of 1024 tokens each, while the base model was trained directly on sequences of length 5120. All models were trained jointly on tasks QA1-QA5 from the BABILong benchmark. The results are presented inTables˜38和and39.

虽然未经微调的基本模型在长上下文输入上实现了接近于零的性能，但经过微调的基本模型可推广到高达 32k 标记的上下文长度。相比之下，ARMT 模型在长上下文分割上实现了更强的性能，并泛化到高达 64k token 的上下文长度。While the base model without fine-tuning achieves near-zero performance on long-context inputs, the fine-tuned base model generalizes to context lengths of up to 32k tokens. In contrast, the ARMT model achieves stronger performance on the long-context splits and generalizes to context lengths of up to 64k tokens.

附录JAppendix J长上下文基线Long-context Baselines

我们将 ARMT 模型与其他长上下文模型进行了比较，例如 Mamba、Mamba-2、DeltaNet 和 xLSTM；结果显示在We compared the ARMT model with other long-context models, such as Mamba, Mamba-2, DeltaNet, and xLSTM; the results are presented inTable˜40。 ARMT 模型在 OOD 和 Long-OOD 分割上显示出相当或更好的泛化能力，优于其他长上下文基线。然而，Mamba、Mamba-2、DeltaNet 和 xLSTM 显示出更好的域内性能，这可能是因为与 ARMT 相比，它们的预训练范围更广泛，参数数量更多。相比之下，ARMT 模型仅用于相对较小的语言建模预训练。. The ARMT model shows comparable or better generalization on OOD and Long-OOD splits, outperforming other long-context baselines. However, Mamba, Mamba-2, DeltaNet, and xLSTM show better in-domain performance, likely due to their substantially more extensive pretraining and a larger number of parameters compared to ARMT. In contrast, the ARMT model is used only with relatively small language modeling pre-training.

我们还用 YaRN 进行了实验We also conducted experiments with YaRN(Peng et al., 2024)用于上下文扩展。按照原始论文设置，我们将 YaRN 应用于 SmolLM-2-360M-IT 模型，并首先在 PG19 数据集上进行调整for context extension. Following the original paper setup, we applied YaRN to the SmolLM-2-360M-IT model and first adapted it on the PG19 dataset(Rae et al., 2020)32k token 长度，400 个步骤，总批量大小为 64。之后，我们在 GR-100+ 和 MT 数据集上微调了适应模型；结果显示在with 32k token length for 400 steps with a total batch size of 64. After that we fine-tuned the adapted model on the GR-100+ and MT datasets; the results are presented inTables˜41和and42。 ARMT 模型在 MT 和 GR-100+ 上均优于使用 YaRN 的模型，而基础模型在 MT 数据集上优于使用 YaRN 的模型。. The ARMT model outperforms the model with YaRN on both MT and GR-100+, while the base model outperforms the model with YaRN on MT dataset.
